The '''portable survival shelter''' was a type of shelters manufactured by [[Gandorthral Atmospherics/Legends|Gandorthral Atmospherics]]. It was very popular among [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] and [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ETU" />
